messages:
mira: ran an overnight cont-batcher sweep comparing dynamic max_tokens cap across us-west (H100) vs eu-west (A100). observed a consistent p95 gap — eu-west ~180ms vs us-west ~120ms on identical replay workload. charts uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3/charts/1719951123/contbatcher-dyncap.png :chart_with_upwards_trend:

perf-bot: benchmark job 2026-05-05-08-12 completed — artifacts: s3://benchmarks/2026/1719951123/ (csv + flamegraphs) :white_check_mark:

alex: same runtime build on both regions? cuda/cuDNN/kernel set the same? :eyes:

mira: yes — identical container image and kernel build. runtime kernel selection is auto; suspect the coalescing behavior interacting with seq-length distribution and tenant mix in eu-west. shorter sequences get grouped into larger micro-batches more often there.

sam: what window / max_batch_tokens did you run for the sweep?

mira: config used for the sweep:
```
continuous_batcher:
  batch_window_ms: 20
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  fairness: per_cohort
  cohort_key: tenant_id
```

jeff: tried reducing max_batch_tokens on eu-west from 4096 -> 2048? might reduce tail. :thinking_face:

mira: quick test this morning with 2048: eu-west p95 dropped from ~180ms -> ~140ms, but aggregate throughput fell ~8%. tail vs cost tradeoff seems roughly linear in this range.

alex: what's the fairness delta across tenant sizes? are small request p99s getting punished by large seqs aggregated into same batch?

mira: small-tenant p99 numbers from the baseline run:
- eu-west small-tenant p99: 270ms
- us-west small-tenant p99: 180ms
Large-tenant median for both regions stayed similar (~95-110ms). So impact concentrated on small bursts.

sam: could quantization influence kernel path (e.g., q8_0 vs q4)? maybe A100 kernel chooser picks a different matmul/attention kernel for q8_0. worth a quick rerun with q8_0 on eu-west.

mira: planned — scheduling a q8_0 rerun tonight with same replay and cohort mix. also enabling kernel debug logging for the first 5k requests.

mira: @alex can you run the eval-suite-3 quality checks on the q8_0 artifacts once uploaded? need to ensure no perf gains come with quality regressions.

alex: on it. i'll run regen+eval and post diffs by EOD.

ops-bot: capacity request created: ticket #4567. region: eu-west. resource: +2 H100 reserved slots. status: pending approval.

mira: next steps: 1) rerun q8_0 on eu-west with max_batch_tokens=4096 and kernel debug; 2) parallel run with max_batch_tokens=2048 to compare throughput vs tail; 3) alex to run eval-suite-3 on artifacts; 4) if q8_0 helps latency without quality drop, consider region-wide rollout canary.

jeff: sounds good. if we still see fairness regressions we should try per-tenant small-request priority lane (micro-queue) to reduce small-tenant p99 without sacrificing large-tenant throughput.

mira: agreed. i'll capture results in the bench doc and ping here when artifacts are up. thanks all :party:
